entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: A Psalm of David. Give to the LORD, O you mighty, give to the LORD glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Give to the LORD the glory due to His name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] on the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD [is] above many waters.

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of the LORD [is] in power, the voice of the LORD [is] in majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; yea, the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: He also makes them to skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: The voice of the LORD goes through flames of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: The voice of the LORD causes the does to calve, and uncovers the forests; and in His temple all of it [is] saying, Glory!

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: The LORD sits on the flood; yea, the LORD sits as King forever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: The LORD will give strength to His people; the LORD will bless His people with peace.
